question: The first edition of the Uber Cup, an international women’s team championship in badminton, was organised in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1956 - 1957.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Uber Cup or the International women's team championship in badminton was first organized in **1956 - 1957.**
 
• Its first edition was held in **England.**
 
• It was first held in the honor of a famous British badminton player, **Betty Uber.**
 
• It takes place every **two years** and a total of **16 teams** are part of this championship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thomas cup** is associated with the **men's badminton championship.**
 
• Thomas cup was started by **George Alan Thomas.**
 
• It was first held in **1949 in England.**
 
• **India** is the current** (2022) champion** of the **Thomas Cup.**
